item.description: Kteippos #6046 the Twice-Born of the House of Chthonius fell (the stone in their midst (House of Hyperenor)). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Kteippos #6046 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Kteippos #6046 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Kteippos is an initiate, and came back remembering.

item.title: Kteippos #6046 the Twice-Born re-knit and asked first for the people they loved, by name.
item.description: Kteippos #6046 the Twice-Born re-knit and asked first for the people they loved, by name. The initiated drink from the lake of Memory.
